Name: Stardew Sprite Previewer
Author: Asakohee
Description:
[b][size=3]📜 Key Features[/size][/b][list]
[*][b]Preview Character Sprites & Animations[/b] – Instantly view character animations and sprite sheets.
[*][b]Custom Asset Support[/b] – Load and preview retextured portraits, sprites, and animations.
[*][b]Animation Details on Hover[/b] – Hover over animations to see details in real time.
[*][b]Easy Asset Management[/b] – Simply replace or add new files in the designated folders.
[/list]

[b][size=4]💻 Installation & Execution[/size]
﻿[/b][b]Windows
[/b] 1. ﻿Download and unzip StardewSpritePreviewer.zip
﻿2. Run StardewSpritePreviewer.exe

﻿[b]Mac OS (Alpha Version)[/b]
﻿1. Download and unzip StardewSpritePreviewer.zip
﻿2. Run StardewSpritePreviewer.app


[size=4]💡 [b]If the program does not run on macOS[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Disable Gatekeeper using the Terminal :
[/list][list]
[code]sudo spctl --master-disable
[/code][*]Right-click the app, select [b]Open[/b], and allow permissions if prompted.
[*]If issues persist, manually build the application using Xcode (detailed instructions below).
[/list]

[b][size=4]🚀 How to Use[/size][/b][list=1]
[*]Select a character from the list at the top of the screen.
[*]The selected character's animations will be displayed.
[*]Ensure the correct folder structure for proper asset loading:[list]
[*][b]BasicSprites/Portraits/[/b] → Character portraits (.png)
[*][b]BasicSprites/Characters/[/b] → Character sprites (.png)
[*][b]BasicSprites/Animations/[/b] → Animation data (.json)
[/list]
[*]Click [b]Refresh[/b] to update asset changes.
[/list][size=3]💡 [b]To preview modded assets:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*]Replace existing files in the appropriate folders.
[*]Add new assets to custom NPCs.
[/list]
